response.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_usage) AS overall FROM s) SELECT AVG(s.avg_usage) AS mean_bandwidth_usage, AVG(s.avg_usage - o.overall) AS avg_above_average FROM s CROSS JOIN o WHERE s.avg_usage > o.overall
